# M11: Units 16–19 and checkpoint E (rhythm), with rhythm playback

Goal: the rhythm units play and sound right. Spec: SPEC §8.6 (beats-of, which-longer,
count-box, finish-box, hear-rhythm; sound-off rule), §8.7, §8.9 (material lessons);
CURRICULUM §8 (R, B, Q, H mixes), §9.1, §10 units 16–19, §11, §12.

## Steps
1. **Audio:** `playMusic` and the click (§8.7) with unit tests against the fake audio context
   (`synth.test.ts`): timing of count-in and events at 80 bpm, rests silent, a new call stops the
   previous one, muted = no-op, errors → the one-time toast.
2. **Domain:** the five kinds, `option` answers, new choice values, prompts/feedback text,
   material-lesson builder for these kinds, sound-off rule, `buildCheckpoint` for cp-e.
   Property tests: every unit 16–19 lesson × 200 seeds × sound on/off (count exact, answerable,
   exactly one finish-box option right, hear options distinct, none when sound is off).
3. **Curriculum data:** units 16–19, `cp-e`, their concept cards (rhythm pictures with "Play").
   ids lock.
4. **UI:** `BeatsOf`, `WhichLonger`, `CountBox`, `FinishBox`, `HearChoice` (auto-play once,
   "Play again", the "Turn on sound" line when muted). Concept-card "Play" for rhythm pictures.
5. **Path/Progress:** units 16–19, cp-e node after unit 19.
6. **E2E** (`e2e/part2-rhythm.spec.ts`): every lesson and cp-e completes via `data-answer`;
   a lesson started with sound off has no listening question; muting during a listening question
   shows "Turn on sound" and the button turns sound on; finish-box wrong answer outlines both
   options; no console errors.
7. Screenshots + visual QA of every new view (light/dark, 390/320). **Owner check** (add to the
   PR text, plain words): play u16-l3 on the phone with sound on; say whether the clicks and notes
   are in time and pleasant.
8. `HANDOFF.md`, `NOTES.md`. `npm run verify` green; "debug again".
9. Replace the throw in `buildNoteLesson` for `render: 'rhythm'` with the real rhythm lesson
   builder, and make the compiler flag unhandled cases (exhaustive switch with a `never` check).

## Review step (Opus)
Review prompt from `docs/build/README.md` with M11.

## Acceptance
- Units 16–19 and cp-e playable with and without sound. `npm run verify` green.
